speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are concerned about your husband's bizarre and agitated behavior; to help me understand what is happening, could you describe exactly what he has been doing and how long this has been going on?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Persecutory Type. While the patient's symptoms of bizarre delusions and functional decline suggest psychosis, the absence of prominent hallucinations, disorganized speech, or negative symptoms beyond withdrawal distinguishes this from schizophrenia.
